poster_title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
authors: Junnan Li, Dongxu Li, Caiming Xiong, Steven Hoi

panels.headline: Unified VLP for both understanding and generation tasks
content: Most VLP models excel in either understanding or generation, but not both.
Performance improvements often come from scaling up with noisy web data.
Proposes a new framework to address these limitations.
Aims to transfer to both understanding and generation tasks effectively.
Introduces a method to generate and filter synthetic captions.

panels.headline: Multimodal mixture of encoder-decoder (MED) model
content: Proposes a new VLP framework called BLIP.
Introduces a MED model that can operate as a unimodal encoder, image-grounded text encoder, or image-grounded text decoder.
panels.figure_caption: Pre-training model architecture and objectives of BLIP (same parameters have the same color).

panels.headline: CapFilt for generating and filtering synthetic captions
content: Develops a dataset bootstrapping method called CapFilt.
Uses a Captioner to generate synthetic captions for web images.
Uses a Filter to remove noisy captions.
Captioner and Filter are initialized from the same pre-trained model and finetuned individually.
panels.figure_caption: Learning framework of BLIP. Captioner and Filter are initialized from the same pre-trained model and finetuned individually.

panels.headline: State-of-the-art results on image-text retrieval (+2.7% in average recall@1)
content: Conducted extensive experiments on a wide range of vision-language tasks.
Evaluated on image-text retrieval, image captioning, and visual question answering.
Demonstrated strong zero-shot performance on video-language tasks.
panels.figure_caption: Zero-shot image-text retrieval results on Flickr30K.

panels.headline: Achieved state-of-the-art results on VQA (+1.6% in VQA score)
content: Achieved state-of-the-art results on image-text retrieval (+2.7% in average recall@1).
Achieved state-of-the-art results on image captioning (+2.8% in CIDEr).
Achieved state-of-the-art results on VQA (+1.6% in VQA score).
Demonstrated strong zero-shot performance on video-language tasks.
panels.figure_caption: Comparison with state-of-the-art methods on VQA and NLVR 2.

panels.headline: BLIP offers a flexible and effective approach to VLP
content: BLIP provides a flexible and effective approach to vision-language pre-training.
The proposed methods significantly improve performance on a wide range of tasks.
Demonstrates strong zero-shot capabilities.
The effectiveness of CapFilt may depend on the quality of the pre-trained MED model.
